title: Pullback tensor counit square with a degree-zero coefficient
statement: Let A be a commutative ring in Type(u+1), f:Z -> W a scheme morphism in universe u, M an A-module sheaf on W, N an A-module sheaf on Z, and k:f^{-1}M ~= N a specified isomorphism. Write F for exact derived inverse image and delta for its specified tensor comparison [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. For any cochain complex P of A-module sheaves on W, let q(P,M):Q(P) tensor^L M[0] -> Q(P tensor M) be the canonical lax tensorator of Q followed by the total-tensor/single-complex comparison; let g(P):F Q(P) -> Q(f^{-1}P) be the geometric representative [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data]. Let s:F(M[0]) ~= N[0] be exact inverse image of a single sheaf followed by k, and let t:f^{-1}(P tensor M) ~= f^{-1}P tensor N be the degreewise ordinary oplax tensor comparison followed by tensoring with k. Then delta ; (id tensor s) ; (g(P) tensor id) ; q(f^{-1}P,N) equals F(q(P,M)) ; g(P tensor M) ; Q(t). This is a counit square for arbitrary P and does not assume M flat or P K-flat. The specified scalar coefficient comparison is exactly upperStarSingleCoefficientIso evaluated on the ordinary coefficient iso of [lem-pur-scalar-sheaf-tensor-pullback].

proof.text: Use the cochain tensor counit square on P and single M. Rewrite the exact single-coefficient comparison as its geometric representative followed by Q of the ordinary single comparison and k. Lax monoidal naturality moves this coefficient morphism through the tensorator.

The proved mapBifunctorComparison_δNatTrans_single₂ and coefficient naturality of mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso identify the resulting cochain morphism with upperStarTensorSingleIso. Naturality of scalarGeometricRepresentative moves the total-tensor/single isomorphism across the representative; functoriality and associativity finish the displayed equation. The proved generic tensor_single_cochain_counit packages this calculation as TensorSingleCounitSquare, so the final theorem specializes it without repeating concrete cochain structure conversions.

Apply scalarCoefficientSinglePullbackIso_eq, preserved verbatim in its separate module: upperStarSingleCoefficientIso evaluated on the ordinary coefficient iso scalarCoefficientSheafPullbackIso of lem-pur-scalar-sheaf-tensor-pullback is the specified scalar coefficient comparison. Both coefficient comparisons have the identical defining composite.

theorem upperStar_single_tensor_representative
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W)
    {M : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)}
    {N : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)}
    (k : (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj M ≅ N)
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ) :
    ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M) ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).obj
          (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))).map
          (upperStarSingleCoefficientIso A f k).hom ≫
        (scalarTensorModelFunctor N).map (scalarGeometricRepresentative A f P) ≫
        tensorSingleRepresentative N
          (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
      L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map (tensorSingleRepresentative M P) ≫
        scalarGeometricRepresentative A f
          (((tensorRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (upperStarTensorSingleIso A f k) (.up ℤ) ≪≫
            (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl
              (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ⋙ tensorRight N)) (.up ℤ)).symm).hom.app P)
